title: Simple Bone Tools (Remastered)
description: Bone tools are now in minecraft! They are a little worse than iron but better than stone.
body:
Minecraft seemed to be missing something.. ohhhh it's bone tools!

This mod adds simple bone tools with wonderful textures into the world of minecraft.
Now, there is a type of tool between cobblestone and iron!
There is not much uses for bones, other than bonemeal and getting yourself a dog, so that's why bone tools were added to the game.
Just use bones and sticks to craft the bone tools.
The remasterd part does not mean anything, but I thought it sounded cool.
**Enjoy the mod!**
